refnamediv.refpurpose: Set the OID output format of the session

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public boolSNMP::setOidOutputFormat Snmp\OidOutputformat
Sets the format in which the OIDs returned by the requests of this session are printed, for instance in the keys of the array returned by SNMP::walk.
This is the same as setting the SNMP::$oid_output_format property to the corresponding SNMP_OID_OUTPUT_* constant. It does not change the format used by the other sessions, nor by functions such as snmp2_real_walk; use snmp_set_oid_output_format for those.
